dispositions.topic_text: Define what INV-06 tests must prove about replay producing no durable writes or mark changes
dispositions.what: Prove INV-06 for a replay by a trace of every durable write while it runs, or by comparing the stored images, placement records and mark records with their bytes and times before and after; check a replay of a marked placement and of an unmarked one; either way A3 rule 2 holds: a replay creates or changes no placement, stored image or mark.
